title: Rated above the overall average
statementMd:
List movies whose average rating is above the average of all ratings. Show title and average rounded to 2 decimals.

Expected columns: `title`, `avg_rating`.

Tables: `movies`, `directors`, `reviews`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT m.title, ROUND(AVG(r.rating), 2) AS avg_rating FROM movies m JOIN reviews r ON r.movie_id = m.id GROUP BY m.id, m.title HAVING AVG(r.rating) > (SELECT AVG(rating) FROM reviews);
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
